keywords.en: All the tables were occupied and it didn’t look like anyone was leaving anytime soon.
So I turned to my friend and just as I was about to suggest trying a different place, he went over to this old couple at a table and asked if we could share the table with them.
I was like “ what the hell are you doing? Are you crazy?”
That’s rude, right?
I mean, I found that really inappropriate.
But to my surprise, the couple were very cool with it, so we sat right next to them.
I mean, I still found that kind of awkward,
but it turns out my friend does that all the time.
